description: Practices are utility disciplines that provide non-combat and combat-adjacent capabilities. Each practice follows the '-craft' naming convention. Practices are chosen at specific levels during character progression. All callings have access to the shared practice pool unless marked with 'callings' restriction.

practices.name: Forgecraft
practices.description: The art of enhancing arms and armour through expert modification. During a long rest, you can apply modifications to your equipment, improving their properties beyond their base capabilities.

modifications.description: Apply one modification per item during a long rest. Modifications persist until swapped at your next long rest. You can maintain 1 modified item at level 2, and 2 modified items at level 6.

armor.name: Tailored
armor.description: Expertly fitted to the wearer. The maximum DEX modifier that contributes to AC increases by 1.
armor.implementation: armor.maxDexBonus += 1 (medium armor goes from +2 to +3, heavy from +0 to +1)

armor.name: Adaptive
armor.description: Layered and angled to deflect devastating blows. Critical hits against you count as normal hits for damage calculation.
armor.implementation: onCritReceived: doubleDice = false, calculate normal damage instead

armor.name: Reinforced
armor.description: Structurally strengthened at key stress points. Grants +1 to AC.

shield.name: Optimised
shield.description: Lighter, harder, and tuned to its wielder. Grants an additional +1 AC.

shield.name: Deflecting
shield.description: Shaped to redirect incoming energy. Once per short rest, use your reaction to add your shield's AC bonus to a saving throw.

weapon.name: Keen
weapon.description: Honed to a razor edge that finds the gaps. Critical hit range expands to 19-20.

weapon.name: Tempered
weapon.description: Strengthened through expert heat treatment. Grants +1 to damage rolls.

weapon.name: Balanced
weapon.description: Perfectly weighted for precision. Grants +1 to attack rolls.

practices.name: Hearthcraft
practices.description: The art of preparing sustaining meals during a long rest. A well-prepared meal fortifies the body and mind, granting the whole party lasting resilience until the next long rest.

meal.description: During a long rest, prepare a meal for the party. The meal grants +1 to a chosen ability score and slows fatigue accumulation. Preparing a new meal replaces the previous one.
